examples.text: Пусть они лучше сами во всём разбираются.
examples.trans: Let them figure everything out by themselves.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'робно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Я потом тебе всё подробно расскажу.
examples.trans: I will tell you everything in detail later.

examples.text: Я могу всё подробно объяснить.
examples.trans: I can explain everything in detail.

examples.text: Шеф, я могу всё подробно объяснить сейчас.
examples.trans: Chef, I can explain everything in detail now.

meanings.note: Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'сказать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will tell', paired with 'рассказывать'.

examples.text: Расскажи, что случилось.
examples.trans: Tell me what happened.

examples.text: Я всё расскажу маме.
examples.trans: I'll tell Mum everything.

examples.text: Сталину расскажите.
examples.trans: Tell that to Stalin.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'on, onto', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Любимый мужчина готовит мне вкусный ужин.
examples.trans: My beloved man is cooking me a delicious dinner.

examples.text: Поставь телефон на громкую связь.
examples.trans: Put the phone on speakerphone.

examples.text: Завтра можете вообще на работу не приходить.
examples.trans: Tomorrow you do not have to come to work at all.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'менить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'will cover for / replace'.

related.gloss: not to will cover for (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Витя, завтра на работе тебя Лёва подменит.
examples.trans: Vitya, tomorrow Lyova will cover for you at work.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и подменить вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and will cover for on time.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go (set off)', paired with 'идти'.

examples.text: Завтра пойдёшь к врачу в два.
examples.trans: Tomorrow you are going to the doctor at two.

examples.text: Может, пойдёшь сегодня вечером с нами?
examples.trans: Maybe you will come out with us tonight?

examples.text: Ладно, я тогда пойду, не буду мешать.
examples.trans: Alright, I will go then, I will not bother you.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'to, towards', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Любимый мужчина готовит мне вкусный ужин.
examples.trans: My beloved man is cooking me a delicious dinner.

examples.text: Поставь телефон на громкую связь.
examples.trans: Put the phone on speakerphone.

examples.text: Вы лучше спокойно дома отдохните.
examples.trans: You had better rest quietly at home.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'the doctor' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Это я соврал, чтобы уйти пораньше.
examples.trans: I made that up so I could leave early.

examples.text: Завтра пойдёшь к врачу в два.
examples.trans: Tomorrow you are going to the doctor at two.

examples.text: Он совсем не умеет мне врать.
examples.trans: He does not know how to lie to me at all.
